query: how to best ship samples to the MSPHL using the free MSPHL courier system?
original_draft: To best ship samples to the MSPHL using the free MSPHL courier system, it is recommended to use the Department of Health and Senior Services (DHSS) contract courier for overnight delivery. This courier picks up at most local public health agency offices and hospitals, although not all hospitals will accept water samples for courier pick up.
edited_version: To ship samples efficiently via the free MSPHL courier system, use the DHSS contract courier for overnight delivery. Most local health agencies and hospitals provide pickup, though some hospitals may exclude water samples.
